Announcement.Title: Welcome to CityLink Initiatives
Announcement.Body: CityLink is your one-stop online portal for local council services, community events, and important announcements. We're here to make government services more accessible to everyone.

Announcement.Title: Community Events Now Open
Announcement.Body: Register for upcoming community events online. From farmers markets to cultural workshops, there is something for every resident. Browse the full events calendar and secure your spot today.
